name: – After § 25 – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Russia’s unacceptable provocative actions and drone incursions into Romania, the Baltic states and Finland
part_text: 25b. Reiterates its call for a ceasefire and for structured, inclusive and transparent negotiations under the auspices of the UN and the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe; calls for the EU to actively support the reconstruction of a pan-European security architecture based on the principles of the Helsinki Final Act;
